_how_to: Copy to <case id>.json, watch the video (or its clip range), and write what you see and hear. Facts are short, checkable statements. A breakdown that contradicts a fact counts as a wrong observation. Leave out anything you aren't sure of. Set written_by and written_at; a case is only scored once both are filled.
facts: Opens with ... in the first 2 seconds
Average shot length is about ... seconds
Captions are ..., about ... words per line
Music is ... at roughly ... BPM / no music
The person on camera ... / no person on camera
brand_terms: Names, brands, channel names or catchphrases from the video that must not appear in the prompt
